definitions.explanation: Being absent from school, work, or a meeting without prior notification or permission.

examples.japanese: {無断欠席|むだんけっせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三日間|みっかかん}{無断欠席|むだんけっせき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was absent without notice for three days.

examples.japanese: {無断欠席|むだんけっせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If unexcused absences continue, it can affect your grades.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧ (without permission) and ⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧ (absence). Used in both school and work contexts. In Japanese culture, where group coordination is highly valued, {無断欠席|むだんけっせき} is considered particularly disrespectful.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無断欠席|むだんけっせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be absent without notice
- {無断欠席|むだんけっせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: unexcused absences continue
- {無断欠席|むだんけっせき}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: treated as an unexcused absence

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}→無断欠勤：17134_mudankekkin⟧: absence from work without notice — specifically for employment
- ⟦{欠席届|けっせきとどけ}→欠席届：08080_kessekitodoke⟧: absence notification form — what you submit to avoid being marked as {無断欠席|むだんけっせき}
- ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧: without permission — also used in ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (without asking)
